incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-58722 fired for hosted-inference - 5xx spike on /v1/generate. Primary on-call did not ack (mobile DND). Escalating to secondary Samir. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-58722

Camille: on it — pulling logs / metrics now. any customer reports?

Raj: seeing 503s from hosted-prod-1 and hosted-prod-2, error rate ~12% over last 5m, p95 latency up to 1.8s. Repro on canary env via replay.

Samir: sorry, my phone was in DND. just woke up — acked (PD-58722) and switching to laptop.

incident-bot: Escalation: secondary ack received at +4m. If no mitigation by +10m will escalate to manager.

Olivia: quick question — any recent rollouts to inference runtime?

Raj: yes, small kernel update deployed 10m ago to hosted-runtime (rollout id r-2026-03-15-10). reverting as a precaution.

Camille: started rollback. infra-bot — can you add capacity while we evaluate?

infra-bot: scaling pool hosted-inference +2 nodes. command queued: `infra scale --pool hosted-inference --count +2`

Samir: running quick health check and tailing logs:
```
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=inference | grep "503" | head
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z inference-1 svc handler error 503 gateway timeout
2026-03-15T10:12:04Z inference-2 model kernel OOM? fallback triggered
```

Olivia: customer-impact? any enterprise customers seeing failures?

Raj: Telemetry shows spike in 5xx primarily for customers on hosted-east region. Enterprise tenant acme-corp showing 75 failed calls in 10m window (support already alerted).

Oncall-Manager: paging manager due to missed timely mitigation. I'm taking over if rollback/scale doesn't resolve in 5.

incident-bot: Manager escalation triggered at +11m and manager acked PD-58722.

Camille: rollback complete to runtime v1.3.3, routing back. Observability shows error rate dropping to 3% and latency returning to baseline.

Samir: confirmed metrics improving. still monitoring for 15m.

Olivia: coordinated with support: sent initial message to impacted customers with ETA and mitigation note.

Camille: quick postmortem notes (will formalize):
- cause: kernel optimization rollout caused regression under certain seq-len workloads -> elevated 5xx
- mitigation: rollback runtime -> decreased errors, scaled pool to absorb burst
- impact: elevated 5xx and latency for hosted-east region, acme-corp partial failures, not data-loss
- follow-ups: add canary gating for kernel updates, extend PD escalation timer to 8m for secondary before manager escalate, add mobile DND override (SMS) for critical pages, update runbook with rollback steps and infra-scaling commands

Samir: action — I will open a ticket to add gating and SMS override. assign to infra + devex.

Oncall-Manager: thanks everyone. capture timeline and assign owners. devex/infra please confirm runbook changes in next 48h. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: thread archived when last_message_ts reached 4303216845.
